0022600154.text: The Orlando Magic (2-3, 9th in the East) host the Boston Celtics (4-1, 3rd in the East) in Orlando's sixth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Magic 0-2 at home and the Celtics 4-0 at home. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), who is averaging 24.5 points per game this season, along with Jalen Suggs (knee), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), while Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series the Magic lost 1-3, including a 113-108 loss in Boston on April 12, 2026.
